name: Sheriff Joe Arpaio
subject: In prison for saving lives?
body:
Not on our watch
Patriot,
This is a disgrace...and every American who believes in law and order should be furious.
Two police officers—Josh Taylor and Brandon Dingman—are currently serving prison sentences for doing exactly what they were trained and ordered to do: respond to a dangerous call, use non-lethal force, and protecting their community.
Let me tell you what really happened, because the media and the District Attorney certainly won't.
On the night of July 4th, 2019, Officer Josh Taylor responded to a domestic disturbance call in Wilson, Oklahoma. When he arrived, he encountered Jared Lakey: a large, fully grown man walking naked down the street wearing nothing but socks.
Josh immediately recognized this situation for what it was: dangerous and unpredictable. Whether it was drugs, mental illness, or something else—this wasn't a man in his right mind. And Josh knew he couldn't handle it alone. He called for backup.
[Donate to Their Defense](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=5595ccf41d264c59ada4791f953df451&_e=MGWGiCuXD88ibM32xP3xCFBOmgUgFTf1U3VS69rCPSOAJjsYrI0xeej6KSGWgAqGJmo-t7GL_3cI9T0qNIagMQjLn3j63YgKsbpHGTtf49rexW-Lu1LbeOZfspyPMX9pl0GRww5olhSpKaRYJqtN1_EyPM-rQj40YArGHti0G17y_zLSePfxZfV0c5wSEr3yWGxtbNLIsC17HvrbWNU42f-8WGloMSsBbXAV9_alcnRovKYhvnIiQHjskdl4iae2nrP_t-0os-p7li3Sv4xgre1sxJKJ6_Iqcxstiws-VzLiVmbH_J4bLvGehPbbHkTZknJ4eynKTurgfx7baemisCUXvd169lGT7J97vIAJ04qg4XlB6o6aamna3f8XqFYuwKdwJcabMwYJOUAj9HEdDykfCMVqrtoKiKEwab2M71eLiFMwsW2z3sdxQ8qiQzQU)
Officer Josh Taylor
Officer Brandon Dingman
Officer Brandon Dingman arrived on scene, and the two officers tried to do what they were trained to do: safely and professionally bring Mr. Lakey into custody.
But Lakey was 350 pounds, combative, and resisting arrest. When verbal commands didn't work and physical restraint proved impossible, they turned to their department-issued, non-lethal tasers.
They deployed them multiple times, but Lakey kept tearing the barbs out. He was clearly not being fully affected by the tasers—and even after repeated attempts, the officers were unable to subdue him.
Eventually, Josh and Brandon were able to get his arms and cuffed him. They immediately called for medical assistance. An ambulance arrived. Lakey was taken to the hospital.
At that point, the officers had done everything they could—and everything right.
But tragically, Jared Lakey passed away two days later. The autopsy was inconclusive. He had an enlarged heart and lung issues. Drug screenings were unreliable due to the fluids pumped into his system at the hospital. There was no determined cause of death.
Even so, the department launched an internal review. Then the City Council reviewed the case too.
Both cleared the officers. That's two separate investigations concluding Josh and Brandon followed procedure.
Case closed, right?
Wrong.
A full year later, a politically motivated District Attorney, smelling an opportunity, dragged the case back up and charged these officers with second-degree murder.
Let that sink in: second-degree murder. He ignored the internal findings. He ignored the medical uncertainty. He ignored the fact that these officers never even laid a hand on Lakey's neck or airway.
They followed their training, used the gear they were issued, and even called for medical help.
But none of that mattered to a DA looking to make headlines.
Now, these two good cops, family men, community protectors, are sitting behind bars.
The National Center for Police Defense is fighting to overturn this injustice. We're supporting their legal appeals, helping their families, and backing efforts to remove the biased District Attorney who never should have touched this case in the first place.
But appeals are costly. And the longer this drags on, the longer Josh and Brandon sit in prison...separated from their families, their children, their lives.
That's why I'm writing you today. We need your help.
[Yes — I'll Donate Today](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=5595ccf41d264c59ada4791f953df451&_e=MGWGiCuXD88ibM32xP3xCFBOmgUgFTf1U3VS69rCPSOAJjsYrI0xeej6KSGWgAqGJmo-t7GL_3cI9T0qNIagMQjLn3j63YgKsbpHGTtf49rSRCQMVKHUvgCD9PHuKZsQCLS5PtX2NZRsWBOptBHRZuDe5r-s59ZCQrDoBke5unT1g6RLujHUi_DB4MyHd8CNDDSRcSduBKJ9mdT7RqouAIt4V_enPvThmUqTqAidTt5CXp9SVi-K02qToKEMvKuLqmH7kVds39Yz-3jVYOHNFmKlxrnHj6SG_tIwv4_bAcZC53Wuhzigc7KmWw-PX8uzqL4Ev7YQNExrUtpmWiH2d4tDNeI8_vzSIBLTlj66H0CAF3dfofo4J5xa_86I1ei_pOWPciJZF-zw56yV2kCw0ge3DT_35YC48yd1u_N3_MKL9mZw6_B-cn9dzKa9cC5Y)
We need to raise funds to fuel the legal defense and appeal process. These officers deserve their freedom. They deserve a fair hearing. And they deserve to come home.
We cannot let this go unanswered. If we don't stand up now, more and more police officers will suffer the same fate: thrown to the wolves by political activists in prosecutor's clothing.
Josh and Brandon were railroaded, plain and simple. And now we need to right this wrong.
Will you step up today and donate to support their appeals?

clean_body: Not on our watch Patriot, This is a disgrace...and every American who believes in law and order should be furious. Two police officers—Josh Taylor and Brandon Dingman—are currently serving prison sentences for doing exactly what they were trained and ordered to do: respond to a dangerous call, use non-lethal force, and protecting their community. Let me tell you what really happened, because the media and the District Attorney certainly won't. On the night of July 4th, 2019, Officer Josh Taylor responded to a domestic disturbance call in Wilson, Oklahoma. When he arrived, he encountered Jared Lakey: a large, fully grown man walking naked down the street wearing nothing but socks. Josh immediately recognized this situation for what it was: dangerous and unpredictable. Whether it was drugs, mental illness, or something else—this wasn't a man in his right mind. And Josh knew he couldn't handle it alone. He called for backup. Officer Josh Taylor Officer Brandon Dingman Officer Brandon Dingman arrived on scene, and the two officers tried to do what they were trained to do: safely and professionally bring Mr. Lakey into custody. But Lakey was 350 pounds, combative, and resisting arrest. When verbal commands didn't work and physical restraint proved impossible, they turned to their department-issued, non-lethal tasers. They deployed them multiple times, but Lakey kept tearing the barbs out. He was clearly not being fully affected by the tasers—and even after repeated attempts, the officers were unable to subdue him. Eventually, Josh and Brandon were able to get his arms and cuffed him. They immediately called for medical assistance. An ambulance arrived. Lakey was taken to the hospital. At that point, the officers had done everything they could—and everything right. But tragically, Jared Lakey passed away two days later. The autopsy was inconclusive. He had an enlarged heart and lung issues. Drug screenings were unreliable due to the fluids pumped into his system at the hospital. There was no determined cause of death. Even so, the department launched an internal review. Then the City Council reviewed the case too. Both cleared the officers. That's two separate investigations concluding Josh and Brandon followed procedure. Case closed, right? Wrong. A full year later, a politically motivated District Attorney, smelling an opportunity, dragged the case back up and charged these officers with second-degree murder. Let that sink in: second-degree murder. He ignored the internal findings. He ignored the medical uncertainty. He ignored the fact that these officers never even laid a hand on Lakey's neck or airway. They followed their training, used the gear they were issued, and even called for medical help. But none of that mattered to a DA looking to make headlines. Now, these two good cops, family men, community protectors, are sitting behind bars. The National Center for Police Defense is fighting to overturn this injustice. We're supporting their legal appeals, helping their families, and backing efforts to remove the biased District Attorney who never should have touched this case in the first place. But appeals are costly. And the longer this drags on, the longer Josh and Brandon sit in prison...separated from their families, their children, their lives. That's why I'm writing you today. We need your help. We need to raise funds to fuel the legal defense and appeal process. These officers deserve their freedom. They deserve a fair hearing. And they deserve to come home. We cannot let this go unanswered. If we don't stand up now, more and more police officers will suffer the same fate: thrown to the wolves by political activists in prosecutor's clothing. Hantavirus cases are being monitored in the U.S., and Ebola has been labeled a Global Health Emergency - and how is the Trump administration responding?
With a total abject failure of federal leadership.
Not only has Trump gutted funding for our public health infrastructure, but right now in the U.S., there is no full-time, Senate-confirmed CDC Director, Surgeon General, FDA Commissioner, OR Assistant Secretary for Preparedness and Response at HHS. That is a serious gap in leadership at the top and is downright unacceptable.
Look, we all saw what happened in 2020 when our country wasn’t ready for the COVID pandemic – and I’ve been doing everything I can since to make sure we don’t end up back in that situation. And Trump’s carelessness is undoing it all.
This isn't a question of IF there will be another pandemic, but WHEN. And a pandemic doesn't care about party politics one bit.

As experts sound the alarm over the decimation of our public health workforce and the research they conduct to prevent outbreaks like these, planning a course of action **now** could be the difference between minor disruptions and mass casualties.

I don't usually send emails like this, but today we’re celebrating.
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=175%2E127862%2EgDTqL2)
Hi there, I’m Berna, Aaron’s wife.
I don’t usually send emails like this, but today, we’re celebrating my husband’s birthday, and the occasion calls for it.
I've known Aaron for over thirty years. We met at a card game hosted by mutual friends the day after Thanksgiving in 1994.
[](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260524_1_ak.m7E2Ie&amount=5&refcode=em20260524-165&t=2&akid=175%2E127862%2EgDTqL2)A picture from our very first date!
Aaron’s mother says he came home at two in the morning and told her he'd met his wife. (She still tells that story!)
Fast forward to today, watching Aaron run for governor and stand up for people who are going through exactly what we went through, juggling multiple jobs to make ends meet and provide for our kids — **I couldn't be more proud.**
**[So today, if you’d like to help me make Aaron’s birthday extra special, consider donating to support his campaign for governor.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260524_1_ak.m7E2Ie&amount=5&refcode=em20260524-165&t=3&akid=175%2E127862%2EgDTqL2)** It would mean the world to our family to know you’re standing with us.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260524_1_ak.m7E2Ie&amount=5&refcode=em20260524-165&t=22&akid=175%2E127862%2EgDTqL2)**
Thank you for reading. And thank you for supporting Aaron.
With gratitude,
Berna Rhodes-Ford

name: James Carville
subject: I’m losing sleep over New Hampshire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire is the map.
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked Senate races in every corner of the country, and I know how to read a map. So hear me when I say this: **New Hampshire is keeping me up at night.**
I’m watching this year’s races closely, and money is pouring into Georgia, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Alaska, and Maine. That’s critical because those races are part of Democrats’ path to retaking the Senate.
But here’s what’s scaring the hell out of me: **If Chris Pappas loses New Hampshire, Democrats need to flip FIVE seats instead of four to take back the Senate. That math doesn’t work. Full stop.**
**[Before you read another word, chip in $5 or whatever you can to make sure New Hampshire doesn’t become the reason Democrats lose the Senate.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260524_2.zs6qM7&refcode=em20260524-2&t=1&akid=6785%2E582294%2EGq5gnk)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260524_2.zs6qM7&amount=5&refcode=em20260524-2&t=20&akid=6785%2E582294%2EGq5gnk)**
Chris is up just one point. One. 45-44. **That is a tied race.** And while the whole country is staring at Georgia and North Carolina, New Hampshire is sitting there in a dead heat with nobody riding to the rescue.
John Sununu — _yeah, those Sununus_ — has the name, the money, and a Republican machine that knows exactly what’s at stake here. They don’t need to flip five seats. They just need to flip New Hampshire red and let the map do the rest.
And right now? **They’ve got a real shot at doing exactly that.**
Chris Pappas is the only guy who can win this seat. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four damn times. He knows how to bring people together. But he cannot — _cannot_ — do this alone when every check is being written and every eyeball is looking somewhere else.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, $5, whatever you can spare. Because if we let this seat slip away while everybody’s watching Georgia, we’re gonna wake up in November and wonder how the hell we let it happen.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260524_2.zs6qM7&refcode=em20260524-2&t=21&akid=6785%2E582294%2EGq5gnk)**
I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire _is_ the map. You hold this seat, and Democrats have a real path to the majority. You lose it, and it doesn’t matter what happens in North Carolina, Texas, Maine, or anywhere else.
Don’t let New Hampshire be the reason we come up one seat short.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260524_2.zs6qM7&refcode=em20260524-2&t=22&akid=6785%2E582294%2EGq5gnk)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
— James Carville
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260524_2.zs6qM7&refcode=em20260524-2&t=23&akid=6785%2E582294%2EGq5gnk)
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260524-2&t=24&refcode2=6785_582294_Gq5gnk&akid=6785%2E582294%2EGq5gnk)**

subject: 🚨Trump just fired the entire National Science Board
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jasmine Clark for Georgia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260524-fires-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260524-fires-rs]
There’s no sugarcoating it: Donald Trump just fired all 22 members of the National Science Board.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260524-fires-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260524-fires-rs]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260524-fires-rs]
This is the governing body overseeing the National Science Foundation, one of the most important scientific institutions in the United States — and he fired all of them. At once.
The National Science Board exists for a reason. It oversees billions in federal research funding, advises Congress on science policy, and helps ensure taxpayer dollars support real, evidence-based innovation.
Now that independence is being stripped away.
Let me say this clearly: When political leaders start dismantling independent science institutions, it doesn’t just hurt scientists. It hurts all of us — because that means fewer medical breakthroughs, less climate research, slower progress on cancer treatments, degraded pandemic preparedness, and more.
As a microbiologist and educator, take it from me: Science only works when it is allowed to be independent, transparent, and guided by evidence — not politics.
But what we’re seeing now is a systematic effort to replace expertise with loyalty, and it’s happening at the highest levels of government.
This is exactly why I’m running for Congress. Because we need leaders who will defend science and protect vital institutions like the NSF.
But I can’t take on that fight alone. We’re heading into a critical stretch of this campaign, and we need the resources to compete against entrenched interests that are perfectly comfortable ignoring science. So I’m asking you: Can you chip in $10 or whatever you can today to help me fight for science, facts, and the future of research in America? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260524-fires-rs]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260524-fires-rs]
When we let science lead, people thrive. Let’s put facts back in charge — and build a Congress that reflects reason, reality, and hope.
Thank you,
Dr. Jasmine Clark
Democratic Candidate for Georgia's 13th District

Orange County Families Are Paying the Price for the Congressional-Corporate Corruption Complex

| |
---
| | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE **Esther Kim-Varet: “Orange County Families Are Paying the Price for the Congressional-Corporate Corruption Complex”** Orange County, CA — Today, I am speaking directly to the people of Orange County and Riverside County about the GKN toxic chemical spill that has displaced more than 50,000 working-class residents from their schools and homes. We are shaken, and we are furious. I want to expose the real-life villains behind this environmental catastrophe — the political machine and defense industry interests that have prioritized profits over the health and safety of our families for decades. Look no further than Orange County and Riverside’s MAGA incumbents Young Kim and Ken Calvert — the same politicians I am currently tied with in this race for Congress. For decades, they have been the top recipients of dark corporate PAC money from America’s military industrial complex. These industries —based right here in Southern California—profit from wars. And these congresspeople are paid to ensure that the profit machine keeps churning—at the grave expense of Orange County and Riverside residents and civilian casualties all around the world. In Congress, both GOP representatives have consistently championed defense manufacturing expansion throughout Southern California while receiving campaign contributions from major defense contractors across numerous aerospace industries, such as Northrop Grumman, Lockheed Martin, Boeing, and Raytheon Advanced Technology, as well as companies connected to other federal military supply chains and technologies, such as Palantir Technologies. All campaign transactions are public. For years, both Ken Calvert and Young Kim have refused to hold town halls or respond to any constituents. Peter,

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Nancy Mace is coming after me... again.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260524-2-io.B-qD5Y&refcode=em20260524-37816&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=37816%2E1203867%2EvMmk04 ]Tweet from @RepNancyMace: 'Ilhan Omar. Shri Thanedar. Pramila Jayapal.
All born in foreign countries, none were citizens by birth. All sitting in
United States Congress. All making clear every single day their loyalty is
not to America. We just introduced a long overdue joint resolution
proposing a constitutional amendment to require Members of Congress,
federal judges, and Senate-confirmed officers to be natural born citizens.
This is the very same standard the President and Vice President are
already required to meet. The people writing America's laws, confirming
America's judges, and representing America on the world stage should have
one loyalty: America. Not any other country. For too long we have allowed
foreign born members to hold seats in this government while making clear
they are America last, not America first. We see it every day. This
constitutional amendment will put an end to it.

Peter,
Nancy Mace wants us to be silent. She wants us to be afraid. She wants an
America for her, and for people who look like her. But that’s not what
this country is, and it never has been.

I’m a refugee, and I was given the opportunity for a new start in America.
I am eternally grateful for everything this country has given me. I ran
for Congress in the first place because I believe in America’s promise,
and I am never going to stop working to make sure we live up to that
promise.

I can stand against anything people like Nancy Mace and Donald Trump throw
my way because I have lived through things far worse than they can ever

clean_body: ...we must honor them while we can It's Gary Sinise here. | | | | Friend, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Hello Fellow Patriot, I'd like to introduce myself.

My name is Jackie Mary Auringer, and I'm running for U.S. Congress because I am no longer willing to leave the future of my community in the hands of people I can't trust.

For too long, the voices of families in the Hudson Valley have been ignored or filtered through agendas, which don't reflect what life is really like here, especially as the cost of living continues to rise and families are stretched thinner every year.

**I am not bought by outside interests, nor am I driven by personal ambition.**

My commitment is simple: independence, integrity, and service to every person in New York's 18th District.

My loyalty is to this community, its families, its future, and its strength.

Our nation is too divided, and it's holding us back.

I believe we can do better.

We can lead with purpose, bring people together, focus on real results, support families, and rebuild confidence in our leadership.

My focus is on advancing practical solutions that support families like mine, bolster local businesses, and strengthen our community as a whole.

clean_body: My commitment is simple: independence, integrity, and service to every person in New York's 18th District. | Hello Fellow Patriot, I'd like to introduce myself. My name is Jackie Mary Auringer, and I'm running for U.S. Congress because I am no longer willing to leave the future of my community in the hands of people I can't trust. For too long, the voices of families in the Hudson Valley have been ignored or filtered through agendas, which don't reflect what life is really like here, especially as the cost of living continues to rise and families are stretched thinner every year. I am not bought by outside interests, nor am I driven by personal ambition. My commitment is simple: independence, integrity, and service to every person in New York's 18th District. My loyalty is to this community, its families, its future, and its strength. Our nation is too divided, and it's holding us back. I believe we can do better. We can lead with purpose, bring people together, focus on real results, support families, and rebuild confidence in our leadership. My focus is on advancing practical solutions that support families like mine, bolster local businesses, and strengthen our community as a whole. I'm a proud Hudson Valley native. I was born and raised there and shaped by parents who dedicated their lives to serving it, my mother as a teacher and my father through his construction business. They taught me what matters: responsibility, accountability, and pride in where you come from. Growing up in that environment gave me a firsthand understanding of the importance of hard work, community involvement, and local pride. That perspective is what drives my commitment to ensuring the Hudson Valley is represented by someone who knows it, values it, and will always put it first. I believe that family is the foundation. This lens formed my values and the way I approach servant leadership. That means being a good neighbor and respecting others. The Hudson Valley shaped every part of who I am, and I am committed to protecting our way of life to ensure future generations can thrive in our community. Just like my family did. So, I'm humbly asking for your support before my first campaign deadline on May 31st as I embark on this mission to give my hometown the representation it's longed for. I've got your back, Fellow Patriot. And frankly, I do not want this to be the last serious message I send to Americans across the country about this campaign because Democrats managed to stop us before November. That would be a bitter, ridiculous ending to a fight we can absolutely win. | Before the window closes Help me keep this campaign moving. | So before you scroll past another campaign email, I want you to read the note I wrote. It explains exactly where this race stands, why Democrats want us buried before June 2nd, and why I believe they are terrified of facing us one-on-one in November. They should be. | Thank you, Steve Hilton Authorized by Hilton for Governor 2026 ]()

Aloha Peter, AANHPI Heritage Month is a time to recognize and honor the significant impact that generations of Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders have made in America. Earlier this month, the Senate unanimously passed my resolution recognizing the importance of May as AANHPI Heritage Month to both honor our communities’ contributions and acknowledge the challenges we’ve overcome and continue to face. _There’s no better way to celebrate Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander heritage than by uplifting the untold stories of our communities._ Did you know that Filipinos first arrived in the United States over 400 years ago, long before our country’s founding? Or that over 120,000 Filipinos migrated to Hawaii to work on sugar plantations in the early 1900s? I carry those stories into every debate about immigration, workers’ rights, and how we protect the dignity of families who come here to build a better life. Remembering the past helps us make better choices for the future. Or that over 120,000 Filipinos migrated to Hawaii to work on sugar plantations in the early 1900s? I carry those stories into every debate about immigration, workers’ rights, and how we protect the dignity of families who come here to build a better life. Remembering the past helps us make better choices for the future. Peter,
**In two days, Republican voters will decide who faces James Talarico in November.**
They’ll choose between John Cornyn, who’s held this Senate seat since 2002, and Ken Paxton, who has made a career out of corruption and attacking Texans.
Either way, Trump gets a hand-picked nominee. And Texas gets another corrupt politician at his beck and call.
[**So before we say anything else about the stakes of this race, will you split a $5 donation between Gina Hinojosa’s campaign for governor and James Talarico’s campaign for U.S. Senate right now?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260524_2_jtalarico.HlZHRI&refcode=em20260524-1184&amount=5&t=1&akid=1184%2E299639%2E4lKnuI)

Greg Abbott has been governor, and Ken Paxton has been attorney general since **2015**. Cornyn has been in the Senate since 2002 — _more than two decades. And what do Texans have to show for it?_
**All we have as a consequence of their poor leadership are higher costs, poorly funded public schools, and corruption.**

James is an eighth-generation Texan and former middle school teacher who flipped a Trump district by showing up, listening, and earning trust. He knows how to win tough races. And he’s ready to take the fight for affordable healthcare, good schools, and basic dignity straight to Washington.
And Gina is running to do what Abbott won’t. Deliver for _all_ Texans. As governor, Gina will work to lower costs, protect public education, and bring real leadership back to the governor’s office.
If we want to beat these corrupt leaders who’ve had their way with Texas for far too long, we need to run a strong campaign all across the state.
**[So if you’re ready to help build the strongest Democratic ticket Texas has seen in decades, split a $5 donation between Gina and James today.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260524_2_jtalarico.HlZHRI&refcode=em20260524-1184&amount=5&t=3&akid=1184%2E299639%2E4lKnuI)**

body:
Sustainer Sunday is back
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260524-2840)
Peter,
For this week's Sustainer Sunday, we want you to meet Maybelin Garcia Romero — a freelance communication designer from West Bend, mom to an 18-year-old who's about to vote in her first election, and one of the more than 3,000 volunteers who keeps this campaign going.
She found Fran the way a lot of people do these days: scrolling on social.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260524.T4Zth1&refcode=em20260524-2840&t=1&akid=2840%2E105371%2EcKHGU1)
* * *
_I stumbled upon the Fran online algorithm after visiting the Madison State Capitol with my 18-year-old daughter. There must've been a Reba McEntire song in the air that day: "A single mom who works two jobs..." You get the vibe._
_After browsing Fran's website for a few minutes and reading her policy plans for Wisconsin, I said, "Sign me up!" to volunteer for the grassroots campaign._
_What excited me about volunteering was the chance to be part of a community that shows up and gives back to a resilient female leader who inspires others to do better._
_A stable income for a single mom with a bachelor's degree should not require working multiple jobs to make ends meet. I feel seen by Fran's plan to raise the minimum wage._
_As a mom and auntie to two nephews, I want to see them grow up physically and mentally healthy — and Fran's plan for universal childcare is why I feel cared for and secure with her on our side._
**_-__Maybelin Garcia Romero, West Bend_**
* * *
Maybelin's story is Fran's story, and it's the same story for many Wisconsinites who are working harder than ever and still coming up short. A bachelor's degree and two jobs shouldn't add up to barely making rent. Childcare shouldn't cost more than a mortgage. And the people fighting to change that shouldn't have to do it alone.
That's why we're running a people-powered campaign to take back Wisconsin and finally deliver for working-class people. And that's why we're asking for your support.
**[Kick in $5, $15, $25 or whatever you can to help us reach more voters](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260524.T4Zth1&refcode=em20260524-2840&t=2&akid=2840%2E105371%2EcKHGU1). **

With gratitude,
Team Hong

body:
| | | | |
# D.C., A Film Premiere, & America's Birthday!
---
---
_L-R: With Solomon at the Republicans Overseas HQ before heading to the Trump Kennedy Center; Vance Day and Solomon headed out of the VIP reception; and a visit to Mt. Vernon - not the one in Grant County!_
---
**DOUBLE TAXATION.** Since my last newsletter, I've lost count of how many times Solomon and I have flown to the East Coast and back. I do know that even after our most recent trip last week, we still have three more D.C. trips in June and July. As Republicans Overseas gets closer to our goal of ending unfair double taxation for Americans who live overseas, which will also benefit our military families, the travel intensifies as do the meetings. We're working weekly with our own team on the ground in D.C., senior White House staff, cabinet-level officials, campaign staff, and others. As we get into the nitty gritty of economic strategy and international tax law, we're holding our cards closer to the chest so that no one and nothing interferes with our efforts. Nothing moves quickly in D.C. and that's by design with our nation's built-in series of checks and balances. If I had to guess, I'd say we're 95% there. If you've been following these newsletters, you know how long we've been working on this effort so you can imagine we're ready to celebrate! We recently met with the White House Council of Economic Advisors, including its acting chair, which was very helpful. **MOVIE PREMIERE. **About a year ago, Oregon's own Vance Day told us he had an idea. The DOJ tends to put together a lot of 500-page reports following its various investigations. The Task Force to Eradicate Anti-Christian Bias would be no different following its look into some of the Biden administration's assaults on our First Amendment. Vance thought a documentary film, complete with interviews of discrimination victims with witness testimony would be powerful. He was right. "By Dawn's Early Light" premiered at the Trump Kennedy Center on May 18 and will be released nationwide on the 31st. People like Alveda King and Dr. Ben Carson attended. One of the event's sponsors was the James Madison Center for Free Speech, headed by Bruce Ash (also of Republicans Overseas) with attorney Jim Bopp serving as general counsel. Bruce, Jim, and Solomon were known as "The Three Suits" in their RNC days and were the trio who fought to protect President Trump's 2016 nomination. They ended up having a surprise reunion at the VIP reception!
Anyway, I can't recommend this film enough. You'll be transported back to the tyranny of COVID and its assault on our First Amendment rights. You'll be fired up with the desire to stand strong to protect our Constitution. You'll also be shocked at how close Biden or whoever was running the autopen came to shifting us into communism. If President Trump had lost the 2024 race, we'd have lost America. The freedom to each choose our own religious path is essential, whether that path leads toward Christianity or another religion. God gave us free will for a reason, and that free will is baked into the Bill of Rights right there at the top.

clean_body: | | | | | D.C., A Film Premiere, & America's Birthday! L-R: With Solomon at the Republicans Overseas HQ before heading to the Trump Kennedy Center; Vance Day and Solomon headed out of the VIP reception; and a visit to Mt. Vernon - not the one in Grant County! DOUBLE TAXATION. Since my last newsletter, I've lost count of how many times Solomon and I have flown to the East Coast and back. I do know that even after our most recent trip last week, we still have three more D.C. trips in June and July. As Republicans Overseas gets closer to our goal of ending unfair double taxation for Americans who live overseas, which will also benefit our military families, the travel intensifies as do the meetings. We're working weekly with our own team on the ground in D.C., senior White House staff, cabinet-level officials, campaign staff, and others. As we get into the nitty gritty of economic strategy and international tax law, we're holding our cards closer to the chest so that no one and nothing interferes with our efforts. Nothing moves quickly in D.C. and that's by design with our nation's built-in series of checks and balances. If I had to guess, I'd say we're 95% there. If you've been following these newsletters, you know how long we've been working on this effort so you can imagine we're ready to celebrate! We recently met with the White House Council of Economic Advisors, including its acting chair, which was very helpful. We were also entertained to find that one of our airing inside the White House! MOVIE PREMIERE. About a year ago, Oregon's own Vance Day told us he had an idea. The DOJ tends to put together a lot of 500-page reports following its various investigations. The Task Force to Eradicate Anti-Christian Bias would be no different following its look into some of the Biden administration's assaults on our First Amendment. Vance thought a documentary film, complete with interviews of discrimination victims with witness testimony would be powerful. He was right. "By Dawn's Early Light" premiered at the Trump Kennedy Center on May 18 and will be released nationwide on the 31st. People like Alveda King and Dr. Ben Carson attended. One of the event's sponsors was the James Madison Center for Free Speech, headed by Bruce Ash (also of Republicans Overseas) with attorney Jim Bopp serving as general counsel. Bruce, Jim, and Solomon were known as "The Three Suits" in their RNC days and were the trio who fought to protect President Trump's 2016 nomination. They ended up having a surprise reunion at the VIP reception! Anyway, I can't recommend this film enough. You'll be transported back to the tyranny of COVID and its assault on our First Amendment rights. You'll be fired up with the desire to stand strong to protect our Constitution. You'll also be shocked at how close Biden or whoever was running the autopen came to shifting us into communism. If President Trump had lost the 2024 race, we'd have lost America. The freedom to each choose our own religious path is essential, whether that path leads toward Christianity or another religion. God gave us free will for a reason, and that free will is baked into the Bill of Rights right there at the top. In the Airstream "green room" and on set in Portland for America 250's "Our American Story" project. AMERICA 250. Back in January, I nominated Solomon for America 250's "Our American Story" project. Just before we headed out for D.C., I received an email telling us he'd been selected along with a handful of other Oregonians. Yesterday, we traveled to Portland to meet the film crew in their Airstream trailer. The interview process took about a half an hour, and I think that all gets boiled down to 3-4 minutes, which they can use on social media or during the July 4 festivities in D.C. The footage will be archived in the Library of Congress. It was funny though - the soundman had a little trouble attaching the battery pack for the mic around Solomon's gun. He apparently was the first interviewee they'd seen in their trek across America exercising his 2A rights! :/ Sidenote: Though the interview took place downtown right in the middle of the Rose Festival, Portland was dead that afternoon. The entire parking garage across the street was empty. Traffic was light. One of the Rose Festival workers told us the entry fee to get into the vendor area just wasn't worth it anymore. OREGON CONSERVATIVE CAUCUS. Mark your calendars! We'll be starting ticket sales for our big annual Trump Day Dinner and Awards Ceremony soon. The event will be in Hood River on Saturday, June 27. Jennifer Van Laar, the managing editor of RedState, will be our keynote. Look for patriotic games, contests, live and silent auctions and more, with live music to wind down the evening. COUNTERSCRIPT: A PERSONAL AND POLITICAL MEMOIR. Solomon's new book is coming out July 4th! All 560 pages of it! The Kindle format is already up for pre-order ~~. Paperback and hardcover formats will also be available, with audio coming soon thereafter. The fabulous David N. Bossie wrote the foreword. Reviews are coming in fast! “... riveting, heartwarming, and most of all—inspiring. America is strong because it welcomes those who know the enduring value of freedom.” —Gordon G. Chang, Political Analyst “... a blend of two great missions—love of all that makes America great and a warrior’s charge to defeat the evil he escaped.” —Steve Yates, White House Deputy National Security Advisor (2001-2005) “Solomon is a good friend of mine and of freedom. What he writes is important and true. Please read this and hear it.” —Tommy Hicks, Former RNC Co-Chair; National Finance Co-Chair of Donald J. Trump for President, Inc. We're very excited! clean_body: The last thing we need right now is more Democratic lawmakers sucking up to Elon Musk. | | | It's hard to believe, Peter, but it's true: Elon Musk may become the worlds' first TRILLIONAIRE next month: 1 The last thing we need right now is more Democratic lawmakers sucking up to Elon. That’s why the Delaware Working Families Party is fighting to kick six state legislators out of office in this year’s primary elections — legislators who helped pass a “billionaire bill” to make it even harder to hold Musk, Zuckerberg, and other ultra-wealthy executives accountable.2 The progressive challengers on our slate are ready to reshape the “corporate capital” of the nation and fight for the people over the powerful. But we need your help to win these competitive primaries. Last year’s “billionaire bill,” which Elon Musk’s corporate law firm helped draft, makes it harder to prove in court that executives are making unfair decisions for their own personal benefit — decisions like Musk’s absurd $56 billion pay package, which the state courts stopped, then reinstated following the passage of the billionaire bill. While the state legislature spends their time appeasing the richest people in the world, Delaware’s working families are hurting from rising costs and mass layoffs. We need champions in our state legislatures who will fight for homes we can afford, healthcare we can rely on, good jobs to support our families, childcare when and where we need it, and time to spend with our families — all of which we can achieve by taxing the rich and getting big money out of politics. Delaware WFP champions Shané Darby, Rae Krantz, Pamela Salaam, Will Imbrie-Moore, Adriana Bohm, and Shay Frisby are ready to hit the ground running to pass policies that benefit working people in Delaware, not power-hungry billionaires. The GOP is showing you exactly what happens if they win this November: They will bring Donald Trump’s extremist, dangerous agenda to New Mexico.
We’ve seen what that looks like: Sowing fear in our communities. Cutting healthcare. Going after essential programs like Medicaid, SNAP, and WIC – the same programs I relied on to raise my child as a single mother.
And here’s what worries me, Peter: With Fox News calling this seat a top pickup opportunity for Republicans, Trump and MAGA billionaires are watching, ready to spend whatever it takes to flip our state red.
They know governors are the last line of defense when the federal government abuses its power. If they flip this seat, they can open the door to that chaotic agenda right here in New Mexico.
But they also know this: if I’m elected, I’ll be a brick wall. I’ve spent my career standing up for working people, and I won’t back down when New Mexican families are on the line. I fought Trump before – and won.

**[▶ RUSH YOUR MOST GENEROUS GIFT NOW](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Don't give because you feel you should. Give because you just watched the United States Department of Justice say our name — **and you want them to have to say it again.** The legacy media will never do this work. The institutions will never investigate themselves. But the DOJ just told the entire country, in plain language, that when WE show up with a camera, federal indictments follow. **[Let's give them the next one.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
In Truth, James O'Keefe Founder and CEO O'Keefe Media Group

When I am out in this district, talking to people at community events and knocking on doors and standing in line at the grocery store, I notice something that breaks my heart a little. People seem deflated. The kind of tired that comes from being used as a pawn in someone else's game for too long and starting to wonder if anyone in power actually gives a damn about you. That deflation is the product of a political culture that has decided fear and division are more useful than solutions. Masked agents at school drop-offs. Lawsuits weaponized against vulnerable communities. Lethal force used against Americans who got in the way. Entire groups blamed and deported to distract from problems that only the ultra wealthy and ultra powerful created in the first place. The cruelty is the point and the goal is to keep everyone else too angry and too scared to notice who is actually picking their pockets. [**Help us build a campaign that offers something different and make TX-03 a district that rejects this cynical playbook.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8wpTS7KCAR5Yma10VmrxhnykwlYX1uxWHtA1Irog3Xy4fDSH_WRzZ0V-jSVsKFm5GYM2GM79auvL-lrRibC-HO1mBn_csQwOYkTSesC3XPXBtLlT5V45ivfr9YuRdfBtBYeadjc1GZ_tc2lr0eF2ym5Rcv8DQPvQ99BvngSViQr1qVpPHR4hz2lQSocGFJHIQJClBO_geHDGvX-Kmj-pW49YYn0z7X2rLcN3k5PKWa0yd9DodlF4O3_ZAU3GPlr5c8-WOs3lk0xCLeBlIQ61J9JqgM9Lp_O8T2x6BzrZwfT9/4qw/SReAnJHrSYuhscPBv9t0bQ/h3/h001.bak6Vrdi0jakkporUH0MuoZl91E_KdvEDeQlNSGCf44) America has never been a perfect country but it has always carried within it a radical and stubborn idea that human dignity belongs to everyone. That the tired and the poor and the huddled masses deserving to breathe free is not just a line on a statue but a promise we made to each other. Americans crossed oceans to fight fascism for it and generations of people marched and bled and went to jail for it. **This Memorial Day weekend as we honor the men and women who died so that promise could survive, it is impossible to look at what Keith Self has built his career on and not feel the distance between their sacrifice and his politics.**
Even our Republican precinct chairs are done with that bargain. Millions of Americans across every party affiliation are done with it. And TX-03 has a chance in November to say so in the loudest possible way. [**Help us make sure that happens.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8wpTS7KCAR5Yma10VmrxhnykwlYX1uxWHtA1Irog3Xy4ixeq3l1VpmbPb9C4dQLAqljS6vi_JtGD23aGXFSP81ii_iuEMI2TXNVkD4HMTvf84DmiQkO25OqEAPkIMA_olzHubcIMtcHDcNNbKPRqPb-Rw4dO2Y5loZ6AmsAYq1e5pz7Cv6G3Lkbq8ecGGvQVHHKleiBxnxZo7to7cpfCVcOsv4Iz1P_rmF8ddfx4eG4rlZw-MDyQh1k_snyN6baJUkXJDUC107V09QajFEndvbWp5RsrzrCVkZ39dGj_Zt43/4qw/SReAnJHrSYuhscPBv9t0bQ/h4/h001.UO1ccTca6jFNTYaY-TmLvKQwms2a5czpTwicH2XEgVA) Very respectfully, Evan Hunt Democratic Nominee TX-03

clean_body: We’re all tired of the hate politics. | | Peter, A few days ago a message came into our campaign Facebook account from someone who identified themselves as an elected Texas Republican. They wrote that they're tired of the hate being pushed by the fringe of their party and grateful that we were pushing out necessary information. I wanted to share that because it speaks to something I have been thinking about a lot lately. | When I am out in this district, talking to people at community events and knocking on doors and standing in line at the grocery store, I notice something that breaks my heart a little. People seem deflated. The kind of tired that comes from being used as a pawn in someone else's game for too long and starting to wonder if anyone in power actually gives a damn about you. That deflation is the product of a political culture that has decided fear and division are more useful than solutions. Masked agents at school drop-offs. Lawsuits weaponized against vulnerable communities. Lethal force used against Americans who got in the way. Entire groups blamed and deported to distract from problems that only the ultra wealthy and ultra powerful created in the first place. The cruelty is the point and the goal is to keep everyone else too angry and too scared to notice who is actually picking their pockets. America has never been a perfect country but it has always carried within it a radical and stubborn idea that human dignity belongs to everyone. That the tired and the poor and the huddled masses deserving to breathe free is not just a line on a statue but a promise we made to each other. Americans crossed oceans to fight fascism for it and generations of people marched and bled and went to jail for it. This Memorial Day weekend as we honor the men and women who died so that promise could survive, it is impossible to look at what Keith Self has built his career on and not feel the distance between their sacrifice and his politics. Even our Republican precinct chairs are done with that bargain. Millions of Americans across every party affiliation are done with it. And TX-03 has a chance in November to say so in the loudest possible way. clean_body: As America turns 250, we must honor them while we can It's Gary Sinise here. | | | | Friend, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Let me be direct.

Nearly two million Texans turned out in the Republican Primary for Attorney General—and despite being massively outspent and targeted by the political establishment and their wealthy backers, we forced this race into a runoff.

That didn't happen by accident.

It happened because the people of Texas still value truth over spin—and results over a bankroll.

The runoff election is May 26 and with your help, we're going to finish what we started and prove, once again, that Texas isn't for sale.

Nearly two million Texans turned out in the Republican Primary for Attorney General—and despite being massively outspent and targeted by the political establishment and their wealthy backers, we forced this race into a runoff. | **A Conversation in the Rain**
---
| |
---
As the lady approached me, I offered her a little shelter from the rain.
---
“I met you before,” she began.
---
Oh yes, I remembered. We had protested together certain actions of the current administration in the charming town.
---
“Is there something else that you’re concerned about? I inquired.
---
“Yes, it’s my grandson,” she began.
---
And she told me the harrowing story of her loved one – that he had been confirmed to be on the spectrum of autism when he was very young. He had needed speech therapy and wore diapers later than the normal age of development. With the intervention of early childhood education before kindergarten, he better socialized with his peers. In grade school, he had daily speech therapy and help with writing since he suffered weakness in his arms.
---
“He had help from a village of good teachers in this area,” she declared.
---
In high school he worked at a grocery store. After graduating, he worked as a janitor, but then, things took a turn for the worse.
---
Unfortunately, he was fired because he couldn’t keep up with the expectations. He hasn’t worked in years and he will be 21 soon.
---
With no access to public transportation and her restrictions on driving, he lives with her so she can best meet his needs.
---
But then his food assistance (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program – SNAP) was cut off. Officials claimed he “appeared” very “high functioning” yet it was clear to her they hadn’t witnessed his level of disfunction as she had for the past 20 years.
---
So now she takes him to the local food bank once a week and worries, as any aging relative would do, about his future.
---
This is why I run.
---
Real people are being harmed by the current administration and this needs to stop.
---
I don’t want her grandson to starve because she can’t take him to a food bank anymore.
---
In the wealthiest nation of the world, he deserves the very basic dignity of nutrition, shelter, transportation, and healthcare.
---
When I am elected, I will work to establish a national healthcare plan so that Americans like her grandson can be properly assessed and not shunted by a system that would rather pay obscene amounts of money to violent insurrectionists or to bomb a country that didn’t attack us.
---
I will also vote to strengthen the social safety nets like SNAP, public transportation, and affordable housing to ensure no matter someone’s shifting circumstances, they will not suffer the indignity of starvation, homelessness, unnecessary barriers to transportation, and a lack of healthcare.
---
I care about the people of PA-13.
---
Please vote for me on November 3rd and [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=0cdc645f38be093015ce3743b5fe31497a15cf9dbfaeadcb7950177349570c71&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7567&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=25320e8f1edfc1f8b255c95973ba366e&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=f0284a7d9c53bdf047dacf4d45ef6b63)!

Hi, it's Jon Ossoff. I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won. And this U.S. Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation. So if you’re upset by what's being done to our country right now and you're ready to fight back, please chip in what you can to support my campaign here in Georgia. **Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260524-2-f&t=3&akid=2298%2E5691347%2E0Glz_Z) Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for the Senate — and why this moment is even more urgent. Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution. More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation. Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning. But now returned to power, this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Threatened to take news broadcasters off the air unless they met his demands for more favorable news coverage.

Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution. More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation. Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning. I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible. We defeated him, and I won. Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
